author: John Hammond
description:
I was digging through TeamPCP and following a bunch of OSINT rabbit holes to see how all these different pieces connected.

The DeadCat X3 handle led to a HackerOne account, a Hugging Face profile, Telegram activity, and other accounts. The same name and profile picture showing up across those places made the connections a lot more interesting.

Full video: https://youtu.be/nj9e2Qfe3Cc?si=cLcEZFbj75Rqa7R1
title: Tracking TeamPCP
